title: Soul Feast #20: Growing Together in Spiritual Partnership
excerpt: In this Soul Feast Gary explores the deeper dimensions of spiritual partnership, a relationship between equals committed to spiritual growth.
bodyHtml:
In this Soul Feast Gary explores the deeper dimensions of spiritual partnership, a relationship between equals committed to spiritual growth. He explains how this new archetype of relationship differs from traditional relationships based on external power, emphasizing the importance of emotional awareness, responsible choice, and mutual support in a spiritual partnership.

Spiritual partnership is not about security in relationships through control or transactional exchanges, as seen in the old consciousness of five-sensory relationships. Instead, it is about helping each other recognize and move beyond fear-based reactions while cultivating love-based choices. 

This journey requires courage, vulnerability, and a willingness to face the frightened parts of our personalities that create power struggles.

True spiritual partnerships flourish when both individuals remain committed to spiritual growth and authenticity. Unlike conventional relationships, which often seek stability through attachment, spiritual partnerships remain meaningful only as long as growth continues. 

By aligning the personality with the soul’s intentions—harmony, cooperation, sharing, and reverence for life—spiritual partners support each other in moving toward authentic power.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (02:26): The key purpose of spiritual partnership: mutual spiritual growth.
  • (04:52): Why being in spiritual partnerships challenges and transforms the frightened parts of our personality.
  • (06:41): How spiritual partnerships thrive when both partners remain committed to growth.
  • (08:55): Understanding the difference between traditional relationships based on fear and relationships between individuals with the new consciousness, based on love.
  • (14:22): Why spiritual partnership requires courage and emotional awareness.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Take time to reflect on your relationships. Are they rooted in authentic growth and mutual support, or do they stem from fear-based attachments? Identify individuals in your life who share a deep interest in personal and spiritual growth. Write down their names and consider how you might explore a spiritual partnership with them. How can you support each other in choosing love over fear? Document your reflections in your journal.
